segs.en: K. Kyuu Sort

zh.ai: K. Kyuu 排序

segs.en: Osu!

zh.ai: Osu!

segs.en: Cindy is helping manage a mixed martial arts tournament that is being hosted at her school. Now that the tournament is over, it's time to get all the competitors lined up for a ceremonial photo...

zh.ai: Cindy 正在协助管理一场由她所在学校举办的综合格斗锦标赛。如今锦标赛已经结束，是时候让所有参赛者排好队，拍摄一张仪式照了……

segs.en: The tournament included $$$n$$$ martial artists from a variety of disciplines and backgrounds. Cindy's analytics team used an assortment of machine learning techniques in order to assign each competitor a distinct power ranking, an integer from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$ that describes their martial arts skill relative to the other martial artists. In this system, $$$1$$$ is the lowest ranking and $$$n$$$ is the highest ranking.

zh.ai: 这场锦标赛汇集了 $$$n$$$ 位来自不同流派和背景的武术家。Cindy 的分析团队运用多种机器学习技术，为每位参赛者评定了一个独一无二的实力排名，该排名是一个介于 $$$1$$$ 和 $$$n$$$ 之间的整数，用于描述他们相对于其他武术家的武术水平。在这个体系中，$$$1$$$ 是最低排名，$$$n$$$ 是最高排名。

segs.en: After all, if there's anything that Cindy learned from YouTube, it's that people love power rankings.

zh.ai: 毕竟，如果说辛迪从 YouTube 上学到了一件事，那就是人们喜欢实力排名。

segs.en: These $$$n$$$ martial artists then arranged themselves in a queue, in preparation for the final photo. We can describe their initial ordering by using a permutation $$$p_1, p_2, p_3, \dots, p_n$$$, where $$$p_1$$$ is the ranking of the person currently at the front of the queue, and $$$p_n$$$ is the ranking of the person currently at the back.

zh.ai: 随后，这些 $$$n$$$ 名武术家排成一队，准备拍摄最终的合照。我们可以使用一个排列 $$$p_1, p_2, p_3, \dots, p_n$$$ 来描述他们最初的顺序，其中 $$$p_1$$$ 表示当前位于队首的人的排名，$$$p_n$$$ 表示当前位于队尾的人的排名。

segs.en: However, Cindy believes that she'll get the perfect thumbnail if this queue is sorted in ascending order. That is to say, each competitor must have a higher ranking than everyone in front of them in the queue.

zh.ai: 然而，Cindy 认为，如果将这个队列按升序排列，她就能得到完美的缩略图。也就是说，队列中的每位参赛者的排名都必须高于排在自己前面的所有人。

segs.en: To make sure things don't get too rowdy, Cindy only has the following two possible operations at her disposal.

zh.ai: 为了避免场面过于混乱，Cindy 只能进行以下两种操作。

segs.en: S to swap the positions of the two front-most people in the queue.

zh.ai: S：交换队列中最靠前的两个人的位置。

segs.en: P to tell the person at the front of the queue to move to the very back; then, everyone adjusts. In other words, we "pop" off the person currently at the front of the queue, then "push" them to the back of the queue.

zh.ai: P 告诉队伍最前面的人移到队伍最后面；随后，所有人调整位置。换句话说，我们将当前队首的人“弹出”，再将其“推入”队尾。

segs.en: Cindy has a lot of things on her plate today, though, so do you think you could help her out with this task?

zh.ai: 不过，Cindy 今天有很多事情要忙，你能帮她完成这项任务吗？

segs.en: The first line of input contains a single integer $$$n$$$.

zh.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 $$$n$$$。

segs.en: The second line of input contains the $$$n$$$ integers $$$p_1, p_2, p_3, \dots, p_n$$$.

zh.ai: 输入的第二行包含 $$$n$$$ 个整数 $$$p_1, p_2, p_3, \dots, p_n$$$。

segs.en: $$\begin{align*}  &\begin{array}{|c|c|l|} \hline \text{Subtask} & \text{Points} & \text{Constraints} \\ \hline 1 & \mathbf{33} & 3 \leq n \leq 5 \\ \hline 2 & \mathbf{33} & 3 \leq n \leq 8 \\ \hline 3 & \mathbf{17} & 3 \leq n \leq 50 \\ \hline 4 & \mathbf{17} & 3 \leq n \leq 250 \\ \hline \end{array}\\  \end{align*}$$

zh.ai: $$\begin{align*}  &\begin{array}{|c|c|l|} \hline \text{Subtask} & \text{Points} & \text{Constraints} \\ \hline 1 & \mathbf{33} & 3 \leq n \leq 5 \\ \hline 2 & \mathbf{33} & 3 \leq n \leq 8 \\ \hline 3 & \mathbf{17} & 3 \leq n \leq 50 \\ \hline 4 & \mathbf{17} & 3 \leq n \leq 250 \\ \hline \end{array}\\  \end{align*}$$

segs.en: Output a single string consisting only of the letters S and P, encoding the commands that you would like to give, in order.

zh.ai: 输出一个仅由字母 S 和 P 组成的字符串，按顺序编码你想执行的命令。

segs.en: If you would like to output the empty string (meaning no operations will be done), output empty instead.

zh.ai: 如果想输出空字符串（表示不进行任何操作），请输出 empty。

segs.en: Your solution will be accepted if this string has no more than $$$10^5$$$ characters. We can show that a solution always exists within these bounds. Note that you do not have to minimize the number of operations.

zh.ai: 如果该字符串的字符数不超过 $$$10^5$$$，你的解法就会被接受。可以证明，总能在这些限制内构造出一个解。注意，你不必最小化操作次数。

segs.en: L. Leisure Geometry

zh.ai: L. 休闲几何

segs.en: Have you ever been to a boring lesson with absolutely nothing to do? Everyone deals with it differently: some students prefer to train their art skills, some try to compensate for the lack of sleep, and Lucas is the only one in this class who does robotics instead.

zh.ai: 你是否曾经上过无聊透顶、完全无事可做的课？每个人应对的方式都不一样：有些学生喜欢练习艺术技能，有些则试图补觉，而 Lucas 是班上唯一选择做机器人项目的人。

segs.en: Lucas has just programmed a robot. It draws a polyline on the 2D plane using a simple algorithm. Initially, the pencil controlled by the robot is located at the point $$$(0, 0)$$$ and faces right along the vector $$$(1, 0)$$$. Then, the following pair of actions is repeatedly performed:

zh.ai: Lucas 刚刚编写了一个机器人程序。机器人会使用一个简单的算法在二维平面上绘制一条折线。初始时，机器人控制的铅笔位于点 $$$(0, 0)$$$，并沿着向量 $$$(1, 0)$$$ 朝右。随后，机器人会不断重复执行以下一对操作：

segs.en: the robot draws a segment of length $$$1$$$ and turns the direction clockwise by $$$\alpha$$$ degrees;

zh.ai: 机器人画出一条长度为 $$$1$$$ 的线段，并将方向顺时针旋转 $$$\alpha$$$ 度；

segs.en: the robot draws a segment of length $$$1$$$ and turns the direction counterclockwise by $$$\beta$$$ degrees.

zh.ai: 机器人画出一条长度为 $$$1$$$ 的线段，并将方向逆时针旋转 $$$\beta$$$ 度。

segs.en: If the pencil returns to $$$(0, 0)$$$ for the first time, and the resulting polyline does not intersect itself, the robot stops, and Lucas calls it a successful operation. In that case, Lucas wonders what the area of the figure bounded by the drawn polyline is.

zh.ai: 如果铅笔第一次回到 $$$(0, 0)$$$，且最终得到的折线不与自身相交，机器人就会停止，卢卡斯称之为一次成功的操作。此时，卢卡斯想知道由所画折线围成的图形面积是多少。

segs.en: We say that the polyline intersects itself if two of its segments have a common point other than a shared vertex of adjacent segments. Segments are adjacent if they are consecutive while drawing, and the first and the last segments are also adjacent if the polyline has returned to $$$(0, 0)$$$ for the first time.

zh.ai: 如果一条折线的两个线段有公共点，且该公共点不是相邻线段的公共端点，则称这条折线与自身相交。若两个线段在绘制过程中相邻，则称它们相邻；如果折线首次返回 $$$(0, 0)$$$，那么第一个线段和最后一个线段也相邻。

segs.en: The first line contains a single integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \leq t \leq 10^4$$$): the number of test cases. Then, $$$t$$$ test cases follow.

zh.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \leq t \leq 10^4$$$)，表示测试用例的数量。接下来有 $$$t$$$ 个测试用例。

segs.en: The only line of a test case contains two integers $$$\alpha$$$ and $$$\beta$$$ ($$$1 \leq \alpha, \beta \leq 179$$$).

zh.ai: 测试用例仅一行，包含两个整数 $$$\alpha$$$ 和 $$$\beta$$$($$$1 \leq \alpha, \beta \leq 179$$$)。

segs.en: For each test case, print the area of the figure on a separate line if the robot succeeds, or $$$-1$$$ otherwise. If the printed value is not $$$-1$$$, the absolute or relative error must not exceed $$$10^{-6}$$$.

zh.ai: 对于每个测试用例，如果机器人成功，则单独输出该图形的面积；否则输出 $$$-1$$$。如果输出的值不是 $$$-1$$$，则绝对误差或相对误差不得超过 $$$10^{-6}$$$。
